body.message:
Thanks for clarifying. Just to confirm a couple of things before we lock this in:

The studio is AED 9,300 per month, all-inclusive. We can secure that rate for your first 3 months starting this Monday. For months 4-12, rates shift with the season, so we'd confirm pricing with you closer to those dates.

Regarding your dog: pets need written approval from the owner. I'll check if a 2kg dog can be approved for this unit and get back to you within a few hours. In the meantime, shall we move forward with the viewing or do you want to sort the pet question first?
